newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, MAY 29 - WEDNESDAY, MAY 7.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, MAY 29 - WEDNESDAY, MAY 7.

text.p: COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-251/95 SABEL: approximation of legislation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 4, paragraph 1(b) of Council directive 89/104/EEC. First Council Directive of December 21, 1988, to approximate the laws of member states relating to trade marks. Possible confusion between a brand composed of a word and a drawing and a mark consisting of a drawing. Identity of the object represented in the two drawings. - Opinion C-337/95 Parfums Christian Dior: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 177, third line - procedure relating to trade marks arising from a question of interpretation of Community law, as it relates to common Benelux law. Court submission. Interpretation of articles 30 and 36 of the EC treaty. Interpretation of article 5 and 7 of Council directive 89/104/EEC. First Council Directive of December 21, 1988, to approximate the laws of member states relating to trade marks. Action of a trade mark holder (of a perfume) and of copyright (for bottles and packaging), aimed at banning a parallel importer from running advertising along the usual lines of the branch concerned. Undermining of the brand's prestige. Damages caused to trade mark holder. - Oral procedure C-188/95 Fantask: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 4, 10 and 12, paragraph 1(e) of Council directive 69/335/EEC of July 17, 1969, on indirect taxes on the raising of capital. Remunerative fees. Notion. Fees imposed without relation to the service provided by the company register. Setting of lump sum fees. Consideration of real costs of the operation. Repetition of the undue. Repayment by member states of fees collected in breach of Community law. Conditions.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-366/95 Steff-Houlberg Export: Community resources. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Community law on applicable national laws regarding "condictio indebiti", on the repetition of export duty repayments unduly paid, in absence of specific Community rules.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-36/96 Guenaydin: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 6 of EU/Turkey Association Council decision 1/80. Worker belonging to a regular work force in a member state. Turkish citizen having benefited from a temporary work permit from an employer, in view of preparing himself for executive functions in a Turkish subsidiary of this company. Request for permanent residence permit. - Opinion C-98/96 Ertanir: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 6 of EU/Turkey Association Council decision 1/80. Worker belonging to a regular work force in a member state. Periods not covered by a residence permit and/or work permit. Effects of work and residence permits specifically limited as to their duration and use. - Opinion C-165/95 Lay: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council regulation 2055/93 of July 19, 1993, allotting bench mark lot sizes to certain producers of milk and milk products. Partial cessation of an operation. Determination of the specific lot size between the transferor and the partial transferee in proportion to the forage area. Notion of "forage area".

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-152/95 Petrides v/ Commission: agriculture. Action for compensation. Non-contractual responsibility of Community resulting from Commission schemes concerning the determination of conditions governing the sale by auction of packaged tobacco stocks held by the Greek intervention body for the period extending from April 1990 to December 1991.
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-20/96 Snares: free movement of persons. - Oral procedure C-4/96 NIFPO: agriculture.
SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-122/96 Saldanha: principles of Community law.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (enlarged) (0915/0715 GMT) - Judgment T-195/95 Guerin Automobiles v/ Commission: competition.
COURT OF JUSTICE, FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-223/95 Moksel: agriculture. - Judgment joined cases C-321/94, C-322/94, C-323/94, C-324/94 Pistre: free movement of goods.
SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-42/96 Immobiliare SIF: taxation. - (1030/0830 GMT) Oral procedure C-314/96 Djabali: external relations.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure T-371/94 British Airways and others v/ Commission: state aid. - Oral procedure T-394/94 British Midland Airways v/ Commission: state aid.
